keyPoints.en: Pie charts show parts of a whole; the circle = 360° = 100%. Include a title, labels or key, and source.
keyPoints.bm: Carta pai menunjukkan bahagian daripada keseluruhan; bulatan = 360° = 100%. Sertakan tajuk, label atau petunjuk, dan sumber.

keyPoints.en: Total → angle = (value ÷ total) × 360° → draw circle and radius → draw sectors with a protractor (largest first, clockwise) → label.
keyPoints.bm: Jumlah → sudut = (nilai ÷ jumlah) × 360° → lukis bulatan dan jejari → lukis sektor dengan protraktor (terbesar dahulu, ikut arah jam) → label.

tip.en: Check that your angles add up to 360°.

keyPoints.en: Compare sector sizes; convert angle → % (÷ 360 × 100) or → value (÷ 360 × total); explain differences.
keyPoints.bm: Bandingkan saiz sektor; tukar sudut → % (÷ 360 × 100) atau → nilai (÷ 360 × jumlah); terangkan perbezaan.
